class Point
  attr_reader :x, :y

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x
    @y = y
  end

  def ==(other)
    return false unless other.is_a?(Point)
    x == other.x && y == other.y
  end

  def hash
    [x, y].hash
  end

  def to_s
    "#<Point:0x#{object_id} x=#{x} y=#{y}>"
  end
end
